description: The template of one game of ImpAI's economy bench (tools/impai/eco_bench.py, which fills in the map and the seat under test and writes the game's own copy): an idle human at StartPos1 and one CORE computer seat k at StartPos(k + 1), fixed starts, mapped, true line of sight, the level's end test off, OTA AI at Hard, commanders only. Seats between them are off. Neither seat names an alliance group, so each is in none: the SKIRMISH Start refuses a game whose enabled seats all share one group (0x479760, "All players may not be in the same allied group."), so two seats cannot be allies. The human is the computer seat's enemy, and with the end test off the level runs on whatever becomes of it. The bench reads seat k's TotalMetalProduced and TotalEnergyProduced at GameTime 17100 and 18000.
